target.title: fix(qqbot): bound gateway websocket payloads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where QQBot gateway websocket connections could accept the `ws` client default 100 MiB inbound message window for gateway events.

## Why This Change Was Made

QQBot gateway frames are JSON control and message events, so the websocket client now uses the same bounded-frame pattern as other channel gateway transports instead of inheriting the broad `ws` default. The QQ gateway websocket docs describe payloads as the `op`/`d`/`s`/`t` JSON envelope shape, not inline binary media: https://bot.q.qq.com/wiki/develop/api-v2/dev-prepare/interface-framework/reference.html

## User Impact

Operators get a tighter QQBot gateway resource boundary while normal gateway events and proxy-agent handling continue to work.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/ws-client.test.ts`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/ws-client.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/ws-client.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig tsconfig.json extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/ws-client.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/ws-client.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- Live loopback WebSocket proof using production `createQQWSClient()`: a normal QQ gateway JSON event passed, a 900 KiB JSON event passed, and a frame above the configured cap was rejected by `ws` with close code `1009`.

```text
$ node -e "const pkg=require('./node_modules/ws/package.json'); console.log(pkg.name, pkg.version)"
ws 8.21.0

$ rg -n "maxPayload" node_modules/ws/lib/websocket.js node_modules/@types/ws/index.d.ts
node_modules/@types/ws/index.d.ts:263:        maxPayload?: number | undefined;
node_modules/@types/ws/index.d.ts:346:        maxPayload?: number | undefined;
node_modules/ws/lib/websocket.js:653: * @param {Number} [options.maxPayload=104857600] The maximum allowed message
node_modules/ws/lib/websocket.js:675:    maxPayload: 100 * 1024 * 1024,

$ node --import tsx/esm --input-type=module <<'TS'
...imports production createQQWSClient(), starts a loopback WebSocketServer,
...sends QQ gateway-shaped JSON frames below and above the configured cap
TS
configured_max_payload_bytes=1048576
normal_frame_bytes=99
normal_events_received=yes
large_valid_frame_bytes=921669
large_valid_events_received=yes
oversized_frame_bytes=1048645
client_error_message=Max payload size exceeded
client_error_code=WS_ERR_UNSUPPORTED_MESSAGE_LENGTH
server_close_code=1009
client_close_code=1006
messages_after_oversized=2

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/ws-client.test.ts
[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.extension-messaging.config.ts

$ pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/ws-client.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/ws-client.test.ts
